stop: No evidence for routing: STATIC_EDGE_ONLY if tradable static is profitable, otherwise NO_NET_EDGE_IN_TESTED_CLASS; missing/incomplete => INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. FRESH_OOS_CONFIRMED impossible on seen data.
